column16: For notices that are reported pursuant to Article 15(1)(b), the indicated category of illegality in the transparency report shall correspond to the explanation of the reasons why the individual or entity submitting a notice alleges the information to be illegal. This may be different than the category of illegality identified and used to action such user notice.
column18: During this reporting period, our user notice and action mechanism operated on a one-to-one basis, whereby each notice filed is limited to a single, specific item of information. Users are required to submit individual notices for each distinct item they wish to report. For total numbers, the user reports and trusted flagger reports were combined.
column20: Per regulatory guidance, cases where we decided not to act on the basis of a notice were excluded from the calculation of the median time to take action. The median time is indicated in hours.
column22: Content moderation actions taken in response to a user notice are organized based on the category of illegality identified by the user in their notice, which may not match the category of illegality identified by the content moderator actioning the notice.
